p: sons in Samaria: The Scripture calls them sons who are either children or nephews.
set him on his father's throne: He wrote this, to prove them whether they would take his side or not.
take ye the heads of the: God as a just judge punishes the wicked children of wicked parents to the third and fourth generations.
righteous: You cannot justly condemn me for the king's death, seeing as you have done the same to his posterity: for the Lord commanded me, and moved you to carry out his judgment.
neither left he any of them: Thus God's vengeance is on them who have any part or familiarity with the wicked.
saluted him: For he feared God, and lamented the wickedness of those times: therefore Jehu was glad to join with him: of Rechab read Jer 35:2.
Baal a little: Here Baal is taken for Ashtaroth the idol of the Zidonians, who Jezebel caused to be worshipped, as it is also so used in 1Ki 22:53.
servants of the LORD: Thus God would have his servants preserved and idolaters destroyed, as in his law he gives express command, De 13:5.
city of the house of Baal: Which was near Samaria.
children of the fourth generation shall: Thus God approves and rewards his zeal, in executing God's judgment, though his wickedness was later punished.
